articles.summary: Experts encourage beneficiaries to review coverage carefully and remain alert to potential Medicare fraud Mattoon, IL (October 6, 2026) As millions of Medicare beneficiaries prepare to review their coverage during the upcoming Open Enrollment period, First Mid Insurance Groups (FMIG) Senior Solutions division is entering the season with national recognition for its performance and expertise in serving Medicare clients. In Senior Marketing Specialists (SMS) latest Key Accounts Leaderboard, FMIG earned four top 10 rankings among 67 key accounts, including third place in ancillary product sales and attachment rate, fifth in Medicare Advantage and prescription drug plan applications, and sixth in year-over-year growth. The Senior Solutions team also submitted 73 more applications in 2026 than at the same point last year. articles.title: First Mid Insurance Group Earns Top Medicare Rankings Ahead of Open Enrollment

articles.summary: Local Employees Share Why They Choose to Stay at the Community-Focused Bank Rockford, IL (October 13, 2026) For First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid) employees Ryan Adleman and Tammy Zurfluh, the reasons they have chosen to build their careers with First Mid come down to something that can be difficult to quantify the people and culture around them. Adleman, who has been with First Mid for nearly eight years, said the authenticity of his first greeting helped him realize he was in the right place. The initial desire to be at First Mid started with Joe Dively, Executive Chairman for the company. He came into a meeting and was down to earth and genuine, and everyone else came across that way, too, said Adleman, VP, Treasury Management Officer Manager at the Rockford Perryville branch. articles.title: People, Purpose, and Community Define the First Mid Bank & Trust Experience
